_comment: F10_clover_forest measured against the DoD bars AS WRITTEN (item 2 = enumerated; residuals = explicitly bounded), per engineering-specs/phase4-measurement-standard-ruling.md. Judgments authored; every fact derived from a pinned artifact at run time. Regenerate: tools/phase4_f10_written_bar_assessment.py

standard.item2_bar: enumerated, scoped to relevant (NOT empty unresolved set)
standard.vocabulary: bounded-exhausted remains a stop decision and never reads as met; this assessment publishes measurement, not disposition
standard.unmeasured_policy: expected and correct where the row has no evidence for a dimension; evidence is never stretched to fill a cell
standard.unmeasured_not_used_because: every one of the nine has at least some derived evidence for THIS row -- the F10 pass was narrow in ambition but not thin in artifacts. `unmeasured` was available and is deliberately unused; if a verifier judges any basis below to be evidence stretched to fill a cell, that cell should become unmeasured.

authority.author_conflict: the assessor is the same author who wrote much of the F10 evidence being assessed; no state here is a promotion, and durable_evidence is carried from the census rather than re-derived by the author of the thing measured

disposition_vs_measurement.row_declares: Mechanism CLOSED: objective law, HUD, exit, piece/bit table, record layout and the bit-0x04 gate -- 46 + 5 static pins plus live confirmation on the Any% run and a breakpoint pass. Only the stage's own route/hazards remain, which is level description. Treat as bounded-exhausted for mechanism.
disposition_vs_measurement.ledger_records: 0 met / 9 remaining, uniform basis ['no active child campaign']
disposition_vs_measurement.note: the ledger's nine-way uniform basis records REGISTRATION (no child campaign exists), not difficulty, and the row's own stop decision never reads as met. Neither is the measurement below.

facts.census_durable_reason: 1/1 declared fixtures intact -- external ones exist, are centrally pinned and byte-match; in-repo ones exist and are git-tracked
facts.suspend_gate_frame_mapping_basis: emulator_frame ~= movie_frame + movie.initial_frame; +/-1 arm-phase ambiguity unresolved and left explicit

derivation_audit.method: every entry of `facts` is assigned from a sha256-pinned artifact read or from a compiled-C pinner executed by this run; the nine bar texts and their enumeration sizes are read out of the pinned roadmap page, so every denominator is derived too
derivation_audit.self_scan: digits surviving in the judgment region after every f-string interpolation is removed
derivation_audit.residual_classification: structural identifiers only -- MIPS register names (a0/a1/a2/a3/s0/s2), the 0x800B memory page, row ids (F01/F10/F11), the item-2 ruling's own name, a source filename, a fact key and an encoding token. None is a measured quantity. If a measured quantity ever appears in this list, the fact behind it was hand-typed and that cell should be rejected.

evidence_pins.path: ObsidianVault/Playbooks/Game Solving Roadmap - From Reconstruction to Reliable Modding.md

original_oracle.written_bar: original behavior has a deterministic cold-boot reproduction with scene/media identity and observable assertions.
original_oracle.written_bar_reading: the cold-boot clause is part of the bar AS WRITTEN; it is not the strict-overshoot reading
original_oracle.basis: 1 retained Interpreter v4 recording of 12036 frames carries media identity (SCUS-94288), a scene gate the tools enforce, and observable assertions (32 registered guards). The behaviour is the game's own: the objective pass is a write watch and the piece pass adds an execute breakpoint -- no injection. The claim it evidences is unusually strong: the five bits arrive ['0x10', '0x4', '0x8', '0x2', '0x1'], out of order (True), which is the case that discriminates a mask from a counter. BUT the fixture is state-anchored at frame 200555 (from_boot=False, reproducible_only_from_state=True) and its start-state hash is backfilled, not recorded (True), so the cold-boot clause of the bar is unsatisfied. Both instrumented passes (2) run over that SAME single recording; no independent replay is registered
original_oracle.gap: a cold-boot run of scene 7 that exercises collection, plus an independent replay. NOT a recording-blocked gap in the way the row implies: movies/Phase4/Interpreter/E02_FreshLoad_Clover.movie.json is already a from_boot=True v4 Interpreter movie of 5562 frames that boots into this stage and is centrally pinned, and the row does not list it (listed=False); whether it collects any piece is UNMEASURED here (offline assessment, no replay)

complete_frontier.written_bar: relevant callers, callees, callbacks, indirect tables, overlays, readers, writers, and downstream consumers have been enumerated.
complete_frontier.written_bar_reading: item 2 asks that the 8 named classes be ENUMERATED and scoped to RELEVANT -- not that the unresolved set be empty (the documented overshoot). The exit gate then asks that what is left be EXPLICITLY BOUNDED
complete_frontier.basis: enumeration is real and correctly scoped to an overlay-local address: 4 resolved refs (2 stores) in REBUILD/files/LEVEL07/LEVEL.BIN, 5 resident readers and 0 resident writers, 20 of 21 scanned blobs with no resolved ref at all, of which 1 never forms an address in the 0x800B page by the absolute route at all -- the one unconditional negative in the set. Callers are enumerated too: 5 call sites of 0x800B3FC8, each with a distinct bit and its own record, all pinned by compiled C (46 passed, 0 failed)
complete_frontier.gap: the residual is COUNTED but not BOUNDED, and Canon says so in its own correction history: 4967 unresolved-base accesses across overlays, 12956 resident, 149 unresolved indirect calls. F01 reached met_candidate here by declaring a bounding assumption with a kill switch; F10 has made no such declaration, and the item-2 ruling is explicitly non-transferable

typed_state.written_bar: important fields have widths, signedness, ownership, valid domains, initialization, reset rules, and confidence-backed evidence.
typed_state.basis: the objective word 0x800B5774 is typed on 3/7 of the bar's own axes: width 4 (lw/sw, pinned), ownership overlay-local in the shared region-A buffer, initialization pinned (store of zero at 0x800B3E9C, observed live). Its domain was observed as a 5-bit lattice terminating at 0x1F (mask_reached_1f=True), and the parallel word 0x800B577C walked [5, 4, 3, 2, 1, 0] in lockstep. Record layout is partly typed: stride 24 bytes with the first 3 words proved to be the piece's world position by the code that consumes them
typed_state.gap: 3 of the 6 record words are untyped; the per-call constants a1 and a3 are unnamed (the row says so); signedness of the mask and counter words is never stated; and RESET RULES are unmeasured -- nothing establishes what the mask holds on re-entering the stage, only what it holds after one init

lifecycle.written_bar: behavior is characterized through creation, repeated use, retirement, death/respawn, pause, scene transition, and reload where applicable.
lifecycle.basis: 4/7 of the bar's own phases carry evidence from the retained run: creation (init to 0 with the counter at 5), repeated use (5 collect events), retirement (the per-piece X-word tombstone, plus a once-only completion latch set at 0x800b44b0), and scene transition (that latch is the level-exit request)
lifecycle.gap: death/respawn, pause and reload are unevidenced AND unregistered -- they are neither shown nor declared n/a-with-reason, which is the form the written bar's 'where applicable' actually requires. The single Any% run never dies in this stage and never re-enters it. The transition's own fade constant is corroborated only statically: the trace tool retains the first 20 fade writes (truncated=True, max value in that window 45), so the absence of 120 there is truncation and NOT a negative

original_interfaces.written_bar: call/return, live state, stack/`ra`, `hi/lo`, GTE, delay-slot, memory-effect, callback, overlay, and asset-loading contracts are known at every boundary the subsystem crosses.
original_interfaces.basis: 2/10 of the bar's own contract classes are addressed, plus the asset-loading one it names last. The intra-overlay boundary is partly contracted: the per-piece update takes the record pointer in a0 (observed in s0) and the bit in a2 (observed in s2), confirmed live on 3 hits. The OVERLAY contract is stated and is the row's sharpest interface finding -- a resident function hard-codes an overlay-local address and stays correct only because it is scene-gated. The asset-loading contract is derived, not assumed (ordinal 10 -> scene 7 -> the LEVEL.BIN of that scene's disc dir, cross-checked against 2 rows already solved)
original_interfaces.gap: a1 and a3 are unnamed; there is no return contract, no stack/ra, hi/lo, GTE, delay-slot or memory-effect analysis at any boundary, and no registered ledger for the resident<->overlay boundary the row itself identifies as hazardous. Enumerated in prose, not as an artifact with named obstructions

campaign_breadth.written_bar: every applicable level, objective, enemy/actor variant, special mode, and exceptional path is covered.
campaign_breadth.written_bar_reading: 'every applicable' presupposes the applicable set is itself enumerated; without that the bar has no denominator
campaign_breadth.basis: 2/5 of the bar's own axes have a MEASURED denominator and are fully covered. Level: the single stage this row scopes, and derived rather than assumed (scene 7 from the progression table, cross-checked 2x). Objective: 5/5 pieces observed set, and the denominator is established twice independently -- 5 call sites in the image, and the counter running to 0
campaign_breadth.gap: the remaining axes ['enemy/actor variant', 'special mode', 'exceptional path'] are not enumerated for this stage at all -- no actor census of the kind F11 ran, no death-in-stage, no re-entry, no partial-collection exit attempt. The row's own `missing` names route and hazards as unaddressed. CALIBRATION NOTE, offered so a verifier can overturn this cell specifically: F01 was judged not_met on this dimension because its applicability universe had NO denominator. F10 is scored partial rather than not_met because two of its five axes do have measured denominators and are fully covered; a verifier who reads 'every applicable' as all-or-nothing should move this to not_met, and that reading is defensible

cross_system_behavior.written_bar: interactions with player state, physics, rendering, animation, audio, HUD, objectives, save/load, and scene transitions are validated.
cross_system_behavior.basis: 4/9 of the bar's own systems are touched with evidence: player state (the collect block refuses while 0x800A6590 bit 0x04 is set; 3 live edges observed, all from ['0x8004eb6c']), objectives (the mask), scene transitions (the latch), and HUD (5 resident reads, pinned, plus a reviewed C reconstruction of the panel)
cross_system_behavior.gap: physics, animation, audio and save/load are unaddressed; the HUD and the sound call are STATIC-only and were never observed firing. Most pointedly, the one cross-system interaction the code explicitly encodes -- collection suppressed while gameplay is suspended -- was never exercised: the nearest suspend edge is 540 frames from any collect (emulator_frame ~= movie_frame + movie.initial_frame; +/-1 arm-phase ambiguity unresolved and left explicit). No combination matrix is registered

source_closure.written_bar: matching or reviewed semantic source represents the complete behavior, and remaining byte/layout mismatches are explicitly bounded.
source_closure.written_bar_reading: the bar accepts REVIEWED SEMANTIC source, not only a byte match -- but it asks that source represent the COMPLETE behavior and that the remainder be bounded
source_closure.basis: the resident half has reviewed semantic source that the row never cites: src_re/hud_800526f4.c::draw_scene7_panel() reproduces the scene gate (True) and all 5 icon bits with their tile-id pairs, and names 0x800B5774/0x800B577C as the five-icon state and the numeric readout
source_closure.gap: no byte match exists for any F10 function: config/segments.yml routes the containing range to asm/hand_written/800526fc_results_screen_render.s (matched_c=False) out of 287 matched-C entries. The OVERLAY code that actually implements the objective has NO source of either kind -- segments.yml holds 0 entries in overlay space and is scoped to the resident EXE. The mismatch is therefore absent rather than bounded, which the exit gate distinguishes

durable_evidence.written_bar: Canon describes confirmed original behavior, Experiments hold reproductions and causal evidence, and Mods describe private state and intended changes.
durable_evidence.basis: CARRIED FORWARD from the measured census, not re-derived (1/1): 1/1 declared fixtures intact -- external ones exist, are centrally pinned and byte-match; in-repo ones exist and are git-tracked
durable_evidence.gap: scope note, NOT a re-measurement and NOT a downgrade: the census measured fixture intactness. The written bar also names Experiments, and there are 0 Experiment notes named for this row (Canon page: 1; registered guards: 32). A fresh verifier may wish to decide whether the Canon page plus the guard module discharges that clause

per_dimension_fractions.complete_frontier: 4 resolved refs vs 4967 unresolved-base overlay accesses
per_dimension_fractions.source_closure: resident half: reviewed semantic source present; overlay half: 0 segment entries, 287 matched-C entries campaign-wide and none for this function

findings_the_row_does_not_record.finding: a COLD-BOOT Clover Forest fixture already exists and the row does not list it
findings_the_row_does_not_record.detail: movies/Phase4/Interpreter/E02_FreshLoad_Clover.movie.json is from_boot=True, v4, 5562 frames, centrally pinned, and boots into this stage. The row's fixture_need says 'None for the objective law'. Whether it collects any piece is UNMEASURED here -- deciding that needs a replay, which this offline assessment does not do

findings_the_row_does_not_record.finding: the live piece pass's own verdict is FALSE and the row quotes only its numerator
findings_the_row_does_not_record.detail: piece_table_confirmed=False: of 5 SCENE-GATED hits at the store PC, 3 landed on a record and 2 did not (1 carrying a bit value that is not a power of two). Bits ['0x1', '0x2'] therefore have no live record mapping at all. The row quotes only the numerator (3 of 3 'valid hits'); the denominator was 5, and the scene gate -- which Canon presents as the fix for foreign region-A hits -- demonstrably did not exclude them

findings_the_row_does_not_record.finding: the collect predicate's 1600 radius has no live corroboration
findings_the_row_does_not_record.detail: 0 of 5 hits were inside the radius at the store PC. Canon explains why (the record's X already holds the tombstone by then) and turns the absurd distance into a confirmation of the TOMBSTONE -- but the consequence, that the threshold itself stays static-only, is not recorded anywhere

findings_the_row_does_not_record.finding: the retracted death-gate naming still lives in an artifact
findings_the_row_does_not_record.detail: analysis/phase4_f10_clover_pieces_live.json still carries static_claims.death_gate ('set only by the death path 0x8004A8E0') and a key literally named death_gate_exercised. Observed setters: ['0x8004eb6c']; death path observed: False. The retraction is banked in Canon, in the row and in the C pinner, but not in the artifact those three cite

findings_the_row_does_not_record.finding: the suspend gate was never exercised against a collect
findings_the_row_does_not_record.detail: nearest suspend edge to any collect is 540 frames (emulator_frame ~= movie_frame + movie.initial_frame; +/-1 arm-phase ambiguity unresolved and left explicit), so the one cross-system rule the collect block encodes has static evidence only

findings_the_row_does_not_record.finding: reviewed semantic C for the F10 HUD exists and the row cites no source file at all
findings_the_row_does_not_record.detail: src_re/hud_800526f4.c::draw_scene7_panel() reproduces the scene gate and all 5 icon bits with their tile-id pairs, and renders 0x800B577C as a VALUE argument to the tile-0x1e draw (True) -- sharper than the row's 'a separate readout'. The same file's header still lists that panel as UNRESOLVED (True), contradicting its own body

findings_the_row_does_not_record.finding: no source substrate exists for ANY overlay -- a campaign-wide cap, not an F10 gap
findings_the_row_does_not_record.detail: config/segments.yml holds 0 entries at or above 0x800B0000 out of 913 (287 matched C, 626 hand-written asm). Every row whose mechanism lives in an overlay is capped below source_closure by the substrate's scope, F10 included

findings_the_row_does_not_record.finding: the F-row census's source_closure triage for F10 is a false-positive substring match
findings_the_row_does_not_record.detail: segments_entries=0 came from a regex on the row stem 'f10', which matched ['asm/hand_written/8006ef10_CD_initvol.s}'] -- a hex ADDRESS containing f10, unrelated to Clover Forest (false_positive=True). The triage line 'measurable: segments/src entries exist' happens to be true for F10 anyway, but for a different reason than the one it computed
findings_the_row_does_not_record.bears_on: source_closure (measurement hygiene, not this row's state)

summary: 1 met, 0 met-candidate, 8 partial, 0 not met, 0 unmeasured -- against the WRITTEN bars. The row's mechanism work is genuinely strong and unusually well pinned (51 static pins re-verified at run time, plus an out-of-order live collection that discriminates a mask from a counter); measured against all 9 bars it is still 1 met and 8 partial, because breadth, lifecycle and interface work were never the objects of the pass.
